{{Youmay|the compact energy pistol known as a stingbeam|the small-sized [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]]}}
A '''stingbeam''' was a compact, easily concealed energy pistol favored by individuals who needed to be discreetly armed, or for individuals who disdained the use of larger weapons.

A typical stingbeam was approximately the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] hand. Unlike a conventional [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], it did not have a muzzle orifice; the end of its [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] was an antenna-like stub. A stingbeam was a powerful weapon, extremely lethal at close quarters, but it had a very short effective range. Most were capable of only a very limited number of shots (typically five) before recharging; when not at point-blank range, these shots acted as [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blasts, unless the wielder chose to use all the charges for one extra-strong blast.<ref name="CGC">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref> The stingbeam made a piercing, whistling noise when fired,<ref name="LCFoO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> and each shot left the weapon hot to the touch.<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] armed himself with a five-shot stingbeam during his time in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]. He rarely carried larger or more powerful weapons, noting that he "preferred to rely on his brains for the heavy firepower," although he sometimes carried more than one.<ref name="LCFoO" />
